⚡ Text-to-Test Compiler IELTS Markdown

Type an Explicit Tag on its own line, then paste your raw text below it. The system will perfectly construct that exact question type.

Explicit Tags (Matches Dropdown)

[Multiple Choice] [Gap Fill] [Drag Drop] [TFNG] [YNNG] [Matching Headings] [Matching Info] [Map Hotspots] [Map Grid] [Writing] [Speaking]

1 Multiple Choice

Mark the correct option(s) with an asterisk (*).

[Multiple Choice]
What is the capital of France?
A) London
*B) Paris

2 Gaps & Drag-Drop

Wrap answers in brackets [ ]. The tag dictates the behavior.

[Gap Fill] OR [Drag Drop]
**Advantages:**
- The quick brown [fox]
- Jumps over the [dog]

3 TFNG & Matching

Use arrow -> to separate the statement from the answer.

[TFNG]
Water is wet -> TRUE

[Matching Headings]
Paragraph A -> iv. The role of government
